text:
alex: CI on main is red after the merge, looks like a multi-tool failure: pre-commit hooks, mypy, eslint and rustfmt all reported errors. Anyone able to triage? :grimacing:

ci-bot: Build #482 failed — job 'lint-and-typecheck' exited 1. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/482 :warning:

sam: :eyes: I'm on it. Can someone paste the top of the lint log?

alex: copying snippets from the job —
```
ERROR: mypy: src/runtime/kvcache.py:124: error: Incompatible return value type (got "None", expected "bytes")
ERROR: eslint: web/ui/components/Editor.tsx: Unexpected any. Use explicit types. (no-explicit-any)
ERROR: rustfmt: src/serve/mod.rs: Diff found, run `cargo fmt`
```

maria: hmm looks like a real typing regression from the cache refactor. alex, did the PR change any return annotations on kvcache?

alex: I adjusted the optional path handling — might have missed a forced bytes cast. Happy to revert quickly if that's fastest.

ben: before revert, can we try a focused rerun + quick fix? I can patch kvcache to return b"" default and push a tiny commit. Also eslint failure could be from a dependency bump — maybe a new rule got stricter.

sam: good plan. I'm going to rerun only the typecheck job to confirm: `./scripts/ci/rerun --job typecheck --build 482`

sam: (after rerun) typecheck still fails same line. ben, if you can open a 1-line PR that coalesces Optional[bytes] -> bytes with explicit guard, I'll queue it.

ben: pushing quickfix now. PR -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/merge/983 :rocket:

ci-bot: Build #483 started for PR 983 — triggering 'lint-and-typecheck' subset.

lisa: heads up — if eslint is flaking we might be seeing cached node_modules mismatch on CI image. If the lint job still fails on PR 983, try clearing the workspace cache for the job or run `npm ci` in the GH action.

maria: also saw one flaky rustfmt report in another PR yesterday; could be rustfmt version drift. We should pin rustfmt in the toolchain file if it's not already. I'll open a follow-up issue.

ci-bot: Build #483 completed — job 'typecheck' succeeded, 'eslint' failed.

alex: ok typecheck green with ben's fix, eslint still red. Error: `Unexpected any` in Editor.tsx — that came from a map over `record.items` where TS inference lost type after a small helper change.

sam: quick suggestion: add `// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` as temporary guard in that line and we can follow up with proper typing in next PR. Want me to push that quick patch?

alex: agreed, but prefer an explicit `as unknown as ExpectedType` cast instead of disabling the rule. Less noisy.

ben: done — pushed PR 984 with the cast. rerun for PR 984: `gh pr merge 984 --auto` (we use auto-merge to trigger CI).

ci-bot: Build #484 triggered for PR 984. Lint job passing, typecheck passing, rustfmt reported minor diffs in src/serve/mod.rs.

maria: I'll run `cargo fmt` locally and push the formatting commit to the branch.

maria: pushed formatting commit, PR 984 updated.

ci-bot: Build #485: all checks passed. PR 984 merged into main. :tada:

alex: thanks everyone. Action items: maria to open an issue to pin rustfmt, sam to add a CI cache-clear step to troubleshoot ephemeral eslint rule mismatches, and ben/alex to follow up and tighten the kvcache typing in a proper refactor.

lisa: noted and added to infra board. Thanks for the rapid triage team. :thumbsup:
